title: Omgång 12 · prov · vinkar till någon snett bakom kameran
summary: Gör en vilofilm av Paow: hon sitter still, och filmen börjar och slutar på ankare 1.

step.label: Vila, samma bild först och sist

reference.why: WAN 3 tar ingen referensfilm tillsammans med första och sista bild.

prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. She starts and ends exactly as in the first frame, and holds still for the last half second. Her eyes go past the camera towards the left of the picture, as to someone standing behind the camera off to that side, and a warm smile comes, her lips together. Her right hand, at the left of the picture, rises from the felt to beside her shoulder, palm forward, and waves twice from side to side in a small friendly greeting, then comes back down to rest on the felt where it lay. Her eyes come back to the camera as the smile softens. Her other hand rests on the felt.
